name: bld3_compact_mutual_nonexpanding_surjections_isometry
statement: {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] {Y : Type*} [MetricSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y] (f : X → Y) (g : Y → X) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (hf' : ∀ x x' : X, dist (f x) (f x') ≤ dist x x') (hg : Function.Surjective g) (hg' : ∀ y y' : Y, dist (g y) (g y') ≤ dist y y') : Isometry f
closed: ∀ {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] {Y : Type*} [MetricSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y] (f : X → Y) (g : Y → X) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (hf' : ∀ x x' : X, dist (f x) (f x') ≤ dist x x') (hg : Function.Surjective g) (hg' : ∀ y y' : Y, dist (g y) (g y') ≤ dist y y'), Isometry f
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld_surjective_nonexpanding_compact_isometry: g ∘ f is a non-expanding surjection of compact X, hence an isometry, so dist x x' = dist (g (f x)) (g (f x')) ≤ dist (f x) (f x') ≤ dist x x'.
type: ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] {Y : Type u_2} [inst_2 : MetricSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y] (f : X → Y) (g : Y → X), Function.Surjective f → (∀ (x x' : X), dist (f x) (f x') ≤ dist x x') → Function.Surjective g → (∀ (y y' : Y), dist (g y) (g y') ≤ dist y y') → Isometry f
